label: Thailand
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels across Thailand -- Bangkok, the beach islands of Phuket, Ko Samui and Krabi, the Gulf resorts of Pattaya, Rayong and Hua Hin, and northern Chiang Mai.
intro: Thailand carries one of the deepest hotel footprints in Southeast Asia. It spans Bangkok's dense city portfolio -- riverside luxury, CBD business hotels and midscale properties near the BTS/MRT network; the Andaman beach resorts of Phuket and the limestone-cliff coast of Krabi; the Gulf islands of Ko Samui; the Eastern Seaboard beach cities of Pattaya and quieter Rayong and the royal seaside town of Hua Hin; and the northern cultural capital, Chiang Mai. Elite recognition and lounge access tend to be strongest at the flagship city and resort properties rather than the more compact select-service hotels.

faqs.question: Which Thai city has more hotel options, Bangkok or Phuket?
faqs.answer: Bangkok has the larger and more varied portfolio, covering everything from luxury riverside properties to business-district hotels near the BTS Skytrain. Phuket's hotels skew toward beach resorts, so the right city depends on whether the trip is city-based or a beach stay.
